title: What a Helicopter Pilot Taught Me About the Future of Quantum
summary: Quantum computing is moving into production, helping enterprises solve complex optimization problems faster and more efficiently.
body_markdown: Quantum computing is shifting from theory to real-world impact, with organizations deploying production applications to solve complex operational challenges. Companies across retail, manufacturing, and telecom are already achieving significant gains in speed, efficiency, and energy use. As complexity grows, quantum is becoming a practical tool for businesses looking to stay competitive today.
